title: Preferences
note: Saved locally. Only affects new blocks.
workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.autoOpen.title: Open the last workspace automatically
workspace.autoOpen.description: Open the most recent available workspace on launch and return to the last board you had open. Turn off to always show the picker.
history.title: History versions
history.description: Save snapshots while you work and restore them from a board's History dialog.
history.limitNote: Keep the newest N snapshots; older ones are removed.
history.clearConfirmBody: Every snapshot in this workspace is deleted. The boards themselves are untouched.
reset.title: Reset defaults
reset.description: Reset block and text styles. Existing blocks are unchanged.
reset.confirmBody: All default styles will be reset. Existing blocks are unchanged.
protected.title: Cannot delete the active workspace
protected.bodyBefore: The editor is using “{{name}}”. Go to
about.title: Version
about.desktopNote: Desktop builds can check for updates in Settings.
about.browserNote: The browser build does not check for updates.
update.title: Updates
update.hint: Check and install new versions from GitHub Releases.
update.installing: Downloading and installing; the app will restart when it's done…
update.manualOnly: Quit the app first, then replace superboard.exe in that folder with the new file.
update.quitHint: Make sure the app has fully quit (no superboard.exe in Task Manager) before replacing the file.
update.readonly: This folder is read-only, so the app cannot update itself. Download the new build and replace it manually.
ai.title: AI
ai.browserNote: The browser build cannot store a key or call the AI. Configure it in the desktop app.
ai.endpointNote: Each slot keeps its own URL and model, so switching back and forth never loses the other setup.
ai.localNote: Ollama listens on 11434 by default, LM Studio on 1234; use whichever one you run.
ai.compactionNote: When the estimated path tokens pass this value, the history is summarised before the next question. Default 100000 (about 85% of a 128k window).
ai.headersNote: One Name: value per line. Gateways like OpenCode Zen require extra headers; opencode.ai gets an x-opencode-session automatically.
ai.keyNote: The key is stored in the OS credential store (Windows Credential Manager / macOS Keychain) and never written to a config file.
ai.keylessNote: Local models need no key; point the base URL at the local service.
ai.clearAllNote: Deletes every key this app stored in the OS credential store, including other providers. Uninstalling does not remove credentials, so clear them before handing the machine over.
language.title: Language
help.title: Help
help.focusBody: Click the focus mode button at the bottom of the sidebar to enter fullscreen. Press Esc to exit.
help.focusNote: Focus mode hides the taskbar and restores the previous window state when you exit.
help.windowOrder: From top to bottom at the bottom of the sidebar: minimize, focus mode, exit.
help.windowDrag: The window has no title bar. Drag the sidebar background to move it, and drag the edges to resize.
start.description: Return to the start page and choose another workspace
